comment: A premise/architecture candidate emitted at the premise layer. The schema validates declared structure; it does not claim those tags prove artistic diversity or quality.

transforming_character.comment: Optional declared locus of change; null supports static, ensemble, or collective structures.

obliqueness.comment: Optional descriptive tag; no value is privileged by the schema.

resolution_type.comment: Open descriptive tag; the schema does not prescribe a resolution taxonomy.

why_not_default.comment: Optional diagnostic note about predictability; expected genre developments are allowed.

formal_intent.comment: Optional statement of the formal or genre effect the premise intends.
